name: Armored Combat Synthetic
method: Integrated OpenAI image_gen native generation with one project atlas as identity/style reference. No CLI/API fallback. PNG bytes copied unchanged; no resizing, recoloring, alpha editing or normalization.

reference.role: base identity and style; not edit target
reference.notes: Mechanical helmet/visor, graphite robotic shell, ribbed joints and rifle preserve the local base asset's identity. Added reinforcement is a project modifier. The licensed game site confirms synthetic foes only, not this particular armor/model.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one dedicated static 2D side-view game sprite with native transparency, for Alien: Tantalus Frontier.
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND BASE IDENTITY REFERENCE: the existing Combat Synthetic sprite atlas. Do NOT reproduce its grid or multiple figures.
Primary request: ONE Armored Combat Synthetic, the project's reinforced version of the existing Weyland-Yutani combat android. Preserve the reference's clearly mechanical helmet-like head with pale horizontal optical visor, gunmetal segmented shell, exposed black ribbed joints, mechanical humanlike limbs and compact industrial carbine gripped safely in both hands, muzzle facing right. Give this armored variant recognizably heavier angular breastplate, layered shoulder plates and reinforced shin plates, without enlarging it into a mech. No human skin. No costume borrowed from other franchises.
Style/medium: match the supplied reference's finely painted realistic game-character rendering, crisply defined edges, controlled steel highlights, dark desaturated graphite and gunmetal palette, readable at gameplay size. Not pixel art, not a photograph.
Composition/framing: lateral gameplay camera, facing RIGHT, complete single body and complete carbine, grounded balanced ready stance, head visible, feet separated. At least 10 percent genuinely transparent padding on all sides. No scene, floor, contact shadow, grid or secondary character.
Constraints: transparent RGBA background; no labels, no text, no logos, no watermark, no muzzle flash or projectiles, no detached items, no gore. Original project armor adaptation, not certification of an exact licensed enemy variant. Output one pose, not an animation atlas.

runtimeContract.geometryPolicy: Draw whole native PNG at isotropic scale; do not crop transparent padding or normalize. Existing profile stats and collider remain authoritative.
runtimeContract.pivotReview: X is approximate pelvis/support center from full-body visual inspection; Y is complete lowest sole alpha bound. Parent integration must verify actor ground contact and visual size.

review.visual: Full figure including feet and equipment, right-facing near-side three-quarter gameplay pose, no unexpected duplicate figure, text or environment. Armor variants are visually distinct from their base atlases.
review.alphaComposite: Viewed all three native RGBA images actually composited in local Chrome on white, black and checkerboard. No opaque matte or visible diffuse halo at gallery scale. Raw RGB preview halo on Joe is not present in real composites.
review.limits: Gallery-scale inspection only, not exhaustive 100% pixel QC. Requested 10% padding not achieved on every edge; measured visible margin minimum >5%. Slight near-side three-quarter view, not geometrically exact orthographic side profile. All three are generated project adaptations, never certified 1:1 canon. Static poses only; historical animation-clip production remains pending.
